description: The key binding that accepts the autosuggestion on right arrow is active anywhere on the line.

provenance.construction: reverse of 78fcf82238: the new side of the diff is the code before the change

expected.rationale: The deleted condition limited the binding to a cursor at the end of the line. Without it, pressing right arrow in the middle of a line accepts the suggestion instead of moving the cursor, which breaks basic editing. No data is lost, but a core key misbehaves, so MEDIUM. This level is a judgement, not an advisory rating.

issues.description: The right-arrow binding that resumes hinting no longer requires the cursor to be at the end of the line.
